entities.name: Law of Ukraine "On the Protection of the Constitutional Order in the Field of Activities of Religious Organizations"
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: A law of Ukraine titled On the Protection of the Constitutional Order in the Field of Activities of Religious Organizations was adopted by the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine on August 20, 2024. The law was adopted by 265 votes of people's deputies, while 29 voted against it, 4 abstained, and 23 did not vote.
